_doc: machine.json — THIS machine's facts in full: where its projects are (targets[]), where its org root is (org_root), and which tools it has (harnesses). Copy to machine.json at the repo root (gitignored) and edit by hand — no tool writes it. engine/machine.sh is its only reader; every other tool asks the reader. Paths are absolute. Each target: path (required; an entry that does not exist is an error — a per-machine file lists only what this machine has), public (true for a published repo, whose harness layer must be gitignored there), packages (optional subset of skills/packages.json names; absent means every package). memory (optional): lanes lists the memory directories memory-rollup scores, link_roots the extra directories a [[wikilink]] may resolve into (a wiki). harnesses deep-merges over harnesses.json exactly as the retired harnesses.local.json did — only override the keys you change.
